name: Open a PR from the list and load its review detail
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click into PR #482 and confirm the detail route loads with the PR title and review surface. Exercises nested routing (/repos/<id>/pulls/<number>) and the per-PR detail fetch. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md). Shares its 'navigate to PR #482' prefix with 04/05 via specs/fixtures/gotoPr482.json.

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: PR title renders on the detail page
